Hi there! The timestamps you see are based on two settings:

1. **Workspace default timezone** – set in **Settings → General**. Changing this will affect anyone who hasn’t set a personal timezone.
2. **Personal timezone** – each user can override the workspace default in their own **Settings → Profile**.

To fix the issue right away, have each team member open their Profile settings and select the correct timezone. If you want a single change for everyone, update the workspace default in Settings → General. Once saved, the new timezone will be applied immediately.

Let me know if you need any help locating those settings!
